description: This PHP source file defines the MimeTypeGuesser class within Drupal, which implements MIME type guessing with support for stream wrapper paths. It manages a chain of guesser objects, sorts them by priority, and integrates with Symfony's MIME type guessing system.

classes.name: MimeTypeGuesser
classes.description: A class that guesses MIME types for files, supporting stream wrapper paths and chaining multiple guessers with prioritization.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the MimeTypeGuesser with a stream wrapper manager.

methods.name: guessMimeType
methods.description: Guesses the MIME type of a given file path, resolving stream wrappers and using chained guessers.

methods.name: addMimeTypeGuesser
methods.description: Adds a new MIME type guesser to the chain with an optional priority.

methods.name: isGuesserSupported
methods.description: Indicates that this guesser is supported.

methods.name: sortGuessers
methods.description: Sorts the chain of guessers based on priority.

methods.name: registerWithSymfonyGuesser
methods.description: Registers this guesser with Symfony's singleton MIME type guesser system.
